verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair thing to ask of a TypeScript agent framework, but the evidence shows none. Studio is a UI for building and testing the user's own agents, templates are clonable projects, and llms.txt and docs.md are static machine-readable docs. None of these is an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
